subject: Wisconsin Election Integrity Newsletter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE REPUBLICAN PARTY OF WISCONSIN NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE
body:
President Trump Needs YOU to Help Secure WI Elections
No images? [Click here](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-e-fsjlll-didthutlhu-z/) [](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-r/) Patriot,**_Election Integrity Update_** Wisconsin elections will depend on committed citizens stepping up this year, and we're asking you to be one of them.The Wisconsin Protect the Vote Program is actively recruiting election observers and poll workers for the upcoming Primary and General Elections. By serving, you'll help ensure election laws are followed, increase transparency, and strengthen confidence in the electoral process.As President Trump noted in his national address last week ([_See Here_](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-y/)), **the radical Left are attempting to steal the Election in November. President Trump is counting on you to help maintain the House or the Democrats will spend the next two years impeaching him and blocking his agenda.** Ensuring Wisconsin's elections are secure by volunteering with the Protect the Vote team will allow you to be part of the national effort working to support our local Wisconsin candidates and President Trump.If you're interested in volunteering as an election observer or are already a poll worker, you can **[create your account here](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-j/) **or click below. [Sign Up For A Volunteer Account](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-t/) **_Upcoming Training Sessions_ - Election Observers/Workers**Election observers and workers fill vital roles in ensuring election integrity. They receive the training they need to identify Election Day irregularities and support our rapid-response team of legal professionals.Election observers and workers primarily oversee **early vote and election day processes.** All observers participating in the Protect the Vote election observer program are _required to attend one training session._ Below are training sessions offered statewide. The statewide schedule of training sessions for election observers or poll workers can be found below:**7/21: Zoom, 6:00pm-7:30pm**. If you are interested in this session, you can [**_RSVP here._**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-i/)**7/22: Zoom, 12:00pm-1:30pm**. If you are interested in this session, you can [**_RSVP here._**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-d/)**_Upcoming Training Sessions_ - ****Special Monitors** Special monitors serve similar goals as election observers/workers, but across a broader range of situations. They receive the training they need to oversee machine testing, view absentee ballot processing, and post-election canvasses.Special monitors primarily observe **pre- and post-election processes.** Like election observers, all volunteers participating in the Protect the Vote special monitor program are _required to attend one training session._ The statewide schedule for training sessions for special monitors can be found below:7/23: 6:00pm-7:30pm. ## Trump Vows Revenge as Iran War Widens
President Trump vowed harsh retaliation against Iran after a [ninth night](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOozAURb_GdEbmATZbuNiGLttuiWz8HN7I4Mh-BGW-fpT8wnRHutK50vl_W26OEh33f25HyzEvB141ITOWhcu5P575qgXZJXJM-SjZZ15AgZbKSOiW4Ci9lqEJNiIC9g3azkyDhqmHqdlsrz2OvcGo1djroEe3euNgRW9UMMo3ZN82ZaDrlBrBtMYNMI0hxj8-dHroxaAwEOfSfmU6eMOYXvmJpV3z3iS7MT-q6P8KmAXM13W16-HX9yhgfqsFzMp8WMB8VknFHbJyccQyR7nlsp_fcsuVKRETVrm6err0wXbjPTXFhsdFKVHVRgzqvjtKn3v-VbOnhZ8AAAD__zbTgUc) of U.S. strikes, warning that each American soldier killed would be avenged "many times over." At least 17 U.S. service members have died in the war, including two at a Jordanian air base struck by Iran. Trump passed the directive to Secretary of War Pete Hegseth. Tehran escalated further, with the Revolutionary Guard claiming two [oil tankers exploded](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOqzAQheGnMR2RGRsMhYvb0OW2WyID4zC7g43MbLJ5-1XyClsf6ZPO_3GdroGY0u1_2NFLzFPCx8kogmWS8r0f9_w4C0pgCkI5lTxnmUBDV2tXQzOtgfg52Wr1ERHQVOgb19sOegN9tXk7Y-OWdgjdYLCJeobezOtsTW8gWr1U5F-adtA0WrfgLi5Y6Ns1xmFem84aZTWuJLlcPjMl2TDyM9-xXJa8V-w3keNU5p-CUcEoG27E_NoUjEdmWp4KRkqCJb0fBFYwtoNzPdiaym2pM3EtIX1hqfHn4HxSTqeCsSp-PR7ETGfnlNW3PdBbruRPqe4efgMAAP__EYh-bQ) in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran-backed Houthis declared a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia. Qatar has floated a [10-day ceasefire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHupCAQxp8GOzY4i6AFxTV2e-2VBmRc5w7BAKvx7S_uK_y7SWbmy-_3_XlNL0uB4vu33dDUJU0RzxKwVsxTzZ9tP9JZMlYbyFZKMSeX6gQCFBeaQzt5S-GaZOPNggj4bNC0upcK-if0zWrU7OTgukHJ2bVSDtAJ5ZR2XS-XBSQ2ZO40oaFthehAP7SV0Hd-WQbnWyWfTAr0VFN-_E0U64pLuNKB-TGnrQlmrXUv7PmLwchgjNeeSr1XDMY7mMEo9HdmMH4Kv_0YjBizfaPnX0d-2hwLp2wjRzuv_FN4ScETZv6PQkDPTwqBO-T2wHj_bTZevNKGhd8sDMYmG7_fZ1SUZlK8N0vhy1h_VOxh4H8AAAD__9UmjYM) to de-escalate. Trump will attend a dignified transfer of the fallen troops Tuesday.
## New York School Hires a Robot Teacher
A rural western New York school district will become one of the first in the country to [put a humanoid robot](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHSmzAQBOCngU4MnPQjpVCRhs5pUzJndDKXCI6RZBPePmO_wl_vzM5--_s235AT749fuJGvUeadzpKoVspzzc_teMlZMlVMjJVlz3KXOkMPo-qtgmEOyOmaTRt8JALSLfnBOjOC0-Da1RsDTuNiEUYkgxbMsrjBatROOzPGlv27rbcwDH3_BbazaMB9hRh_3MMwGt2YngJXyd0f4b2uFNMlL8rdIlub_FrrURr9s4Gpgek8zy7Kv7finTcwbRQYG5h2OtUl-a8qyyqSVOBSMy9VBTqSXGp9brgLB_UhqiVhKVlkKypiSm324Tg5JS6jbUz_2JDTZ0H91m0vD_8DAAD___G3hOY) in the classroom this fall, starting in its high school AI and robotics classes on the Seneca Nation reservation. The robot costs $57,590, is named Sally, and has silicone skin, long brown hair, facial expressions, and upper-body movements. The company that built her, Realbotix, also has a history of making lifelike dolls designed for intimacy. [See a photo here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyqzAQRb9GdGLEgoVcqHgNnV-bkhFoZTYRkkdaQ_z3GecXUt87Z86cj9t8cxQp3f-7HS2HPCc8a0RmLDOX5_448lkLsovkmHIqeck8gwIt1Sihm72j-JqHxtuACNg3aLvRDBpMD6bZ7LiGzmuvL6CubkGzBNcbo1Gb6-AR1obsm6ZG6DqlLjC2oxvAXHwI18V3eujFoNAT59J-Zkq8YYivfGBp17w30W7Mjyr6fwImAdN5nq3Hbyyc37uACRNjYUdpx8QCprpuOUdZ8EAXq4wUMNIXyu25u5TJS0a3blgkb47lSTHKBSUluUZXK1Z5YHnJmnOSfW-MMkbA1BTrH-8vVT2KQd13R_FXkP9U9bDwEwAA__85A49w). Sally stays permanently seated and tutors students who log in with a unique code, letting her pick up where each left off. Officials said she [isn't connected to the internet](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OpDAQBOCnMZmRabw2Gzi4hGwvvRD1-Af6ztgI94Lm7U8zr7BxSaWv6s_X8oWUqay_cY-OU11KvFuOzPFc-Pzej6ve7YyMmZCplrM-Ki-gwEhlJQxLQMrPRXfBpRghjl10g520gWmEqdvcwxqvFEyjTiElYwcwwXijP5UJ1o7YkXu1KQvDoNQH2N6ihukjpPT5CIPRo9AqBuJ69n8rFd5iys96xbP3de-y25iPJsZfAmYB833f_Vovjn575QLmGL79my5g_icHEDA3zLhj8SiLfMrmt1pzk1zlQbmyRJLvmZIj-o3KKrE1aoyFu9OF46acqRkrtFp3pPyG8I_euxz8DwAA___NqIYI) and has guardrails blocking off-limits topics. Not everyone is sold. Some [parents reportedly raised concerns](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSrCAQRb8GMyxsUTQgeInZvHRDC6UZ2UWYwnao-fst_YVNu2_dOud-PeaH8cHH53-zoyaX5ojlCEiEeaZ87q93KkdGMsEb8inmtCSaQUDPheLQzNb48JllZbVDBGwr1I0aZA9DC0O1aTe2xg5u7BaUjRKrWRc1DGPTyd7Y3kHl9dUmFDSNEB2oWhkJQ2edGxfb9LJlUqD1lHL9nXykDV34pDfmek17FfRG9DpY-4_BxGAqpdSXQrxpYypXisF0Hvw6M5jQnuv9ZDBFLPyT8g8_1i2lwK0_KPuV-HbuJiZv-e3LCc26YWYwVVnbV_Eh-KNXTIrnbny4SehP8701_AYAAP__uAKH7w) about privacy, in a district where most students are economically disadvantaged.
## Five Coffees a Day Linked to Health Benefits
Most adults can safely drink up to five cups of coffee a day, [according to a new statement](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOnDAQhJ8GOiNjDOYvXKS57tKmRAu7PpwYLzJ7h3j76E7JE_zNFDOa0af5dZ_uEFPMj5-wkZfAU6bzSCRCZZLy3PYXn0chgRRBIufCM8tktBmUdsq0E0JM12Rr9IHIUFeTb91oBzN2ZqxXP7c4B6TR9V-IThMN2Oo-WAe2o37p6ujfa9qZttW6N65xYM3YYwhfM7aD7SqrCaNwaX5zzLJSSBe_qDQLb3Xyq8h-VN2Pytwqc3vjF-atWQmKNFwe_8zK3BYOgUhBRvVJ35pkVSufaoN8qeW5H4qDWiAEihmEUP0vFVIHBFLCCkvMfxTBsiqEqy4e9zOmFI_BVVY_NojpwybfOvTlzd8AAAD__4Uajj0) from the American Heart Association pegging the ceiling at 400 milligrams of caffeine. Regularly sipping caffeinated coffee was [linked to lower risk](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGOpCAURb8Gd1TggYoLFpNM3NVsJp1eGpRHSQfFwKsy_n2n-hd6fZObc87nfbq7mOL--Oc2tBTytONZExJhmag8t-OVz1qQXIqOYt5LnjNNIKDjoucgJ-9iuibdeBsQAVWDVvZGd2AUmGa17WCkEbPGsPg5tNiKwZu-06BD0HJYmmjfb6IHKYVoob_1ToNpfQjD7GWnFdMCfaRcbl857rRiSFd-YbkteWuSXYmOytQfBiOD0c3L2-C9MRg__jMYW748j8qXHAIi9-7iRybcKbqULp7yiYWv6ApxHyu6igzGSrlcTI3RM_VXKj2IFpRqivXHGVOKteuZFo_NxfSDQb9q97LwHQAA__9H04NM) of Type 2 diabetes, heart disease, stroke, heart failure, and some irregular heart rhythms, doctors said. There's a catch: the [benefits shrink](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-O4yAQxp8Gd0QwtsEpKK5xl2uvtCYw2HOLIcJsorz9KskjbDfSfPp9f_5dlgty4rz-xZ1ci2XJ9DgStUZ1afV7v93L46jUMDE2LrmWa2kLKDBSWQl6CcjpuQxdcJEIqO_IaTsNBqYepm5zUY9A1p_HnhAmUgqN0Qa8sjTpPlw7di-asqC1UiPYk8UBpjHEeL4GbYZeDIoCt1JP_wvntlFMz3KnevJl75LbWrsdov8jYBYwv-N4TOnzFzC_6AJmZd_3S1I5f3FepS8xEsm1lCBxp8oes9wIa5N4HMV_GguYu-rC7cEp8WGsGNS6I6e3ffvVZncHPwEAAP__jxeASQ) once you add sugar, flavors, or cream. Black is best. Researchers cautioned that most caffeine studies are observational and can't prove cause and effect. They also warned that [energy drinks](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSpCAQhJ8GM7ZgRNGA4BKz_9ILrVGGX65QLJjdLd_-yr1H-LMJpru_7j9f8xfGFI_v37iT45Dng941ETOVmctzP1_5XQsxpogc81HyknkGBb1UVoKePcZ0zabxLhABtQ05bQfTw9DC0Gxu0WT1ErQ2re_tOqhRdx1hMJb02Oqxie52Uxa0VqoD-7BoYOh8COPidW9aYRT5yLk8_uZ48EYhXflF5bHmvUluYz6raH8JmARMH5w1h0B0N7l_BEx3goBJ2c8tYMINZcWrSt5ilTsel1yfZ5U5yP9ieVKRHi8Zq6wYSIZc5J4rS_TPxFXA1BTnz3dMKdbeCqO-d4zpA8U_WvLl4F8AAAD__7aCh8s), with far more caffeine per ounce, can trigger dangerous heart rhythms.

| | **A 10-Day Ceasefire Would Reopen the Strait. Brent Would Drop $10–15. Asian LNG Spot Prices Would Fall. Gasoline Would Stop Rising. Here Is the Energy Math of a Pause.**
---
| | If the 10-day ceasefire proposal floating through mediators today is accepted, the energy market impact would be immediate and significant. The previous ceasefire experience — April 8 to July 8 — produced a Brent decline from approximately $107/barrel at the April peak to $68/barrel by July 1, a $39 decline in 84 days, or roughly $0.46/barrel per day. The June 17 MOU signing alone caused Brent to drop $22/barrel in one month (May to June average, per EIA). A 10-day pause accepted today would not replicate that full decline — too much structural damage has been done to the Strait's operational reliability and to market confidence in the MOU framework. But even a partial recovery of Strait traffic would likely pull Brent from $90+ toward the mid-$80s as risk premium deflates. Every $5 decline in Brent translates to approximately 12 cents off retail gasoline. The Republican midterm calculation is straightforward: the faster the war pauses, the lower the pump price in October.
---
| | Asian LNG spot prices, up 10% this week to their highest since March, would also soften on ceasefire news — as Qatari, UAE, and other Gulf LNG carriers could resume Hormuz transits. The Pakistani emergency LNG purchases, the South Korean Red Sea rerouting, and the European emergency storage top-up programs all become less urgent in a pause environment. The IEA's July OMR recovery scenario — 7.5 mb/d of new supply in 2027 "if transit volumes improve" — becomes plausible again. The EIA's August 11 STEO, now 21 days away, would be written with sharply different assumptions if a 10-day pause begins this week. The energy market is not waiting for the ceasefire to be announced — it is pre-pricing the possibility. Brent's behavior in the next 24 hours will tell you whether traders think the 10-day proposal is real or noise.

## Texas Shifts from Response to Recovery
Gov. Greg Abbott said Monday that Texas is shifting from emergency response to recovery after last week's floods [damaged about 490 homes](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LvSmzAQBeCnEZ08umAuhYo0dH_alMzCLngTgRhpg-23z-AiL_B3W-yc-c759TV-AUfe15-wUZDXksadniWSCOVR6AWlpIhM-Q_HSMj775QRRmdco02rnR0ROL7HusIwGextRcG2Xd1423ZN9Qh2xh6oN95RD0vT-qlbrMf5vtydoRkqDleYaZ211njjbx7qO04Ouxlq5xujakPIkvJNHvQhLfGdTsq3OW1VDA-Royj_Q7lBuaHADvtKMUU-6fpQbrgqKTccKbLwfJ3__Ua5YU2nhmlKIvrI6WSkov8eCEIaFqGsTy4svK96iSmhRthgJdSQCUqVAx5PjpFL06rarBtw_Mjke3uewf0LAAD__8ibjCA) across the state. Abbott surveyed the Kerrville area by helicopter before meeting with state and local emergency officials on cleanup, debris removal, and infrastructure repairs.
